::: {.lead-intro}
Maps for curious kids, each with its own theme. Print them, stick them on the wall, and see what you can find. These are the little sisters of my [cARTography](../cartography/) maps, and I'll be adding more.
:::

## Where do pumpkins grow?

A Halloween map of the world, with one pumpkin for every 500,000 tonnes grown in a year. Most of them are in India and China, but can you find the single pumpkins hiding in Peru, Malawi and Cuba?

![**Where do pumpkins grow?** Pumpkins, squash and gourds grown in 2024. Data: FAOSTAT (FAO). Map: Natural Earth.](img/where-do-pumpkins-grow.jpg){group="kids" fig-alt="A night-time world map with piles of cartoon pumpkins on the countries that grow the most, the biggest piles on India and China"}

<p class="links"><a href="downloads/where-do-pumpkins-grow-A3.pdf">Download the A3 print (PDF)</a></p>

## Kingston, in blocks

A blocky adventure map of Kingston upon Thames, Bushy Park and Hampton Court, built from OpenStreetMap. Find all ten places on the list: the palace, the maze, the deer, the toppled phone boxes and, of course, the ice cream.

![**Kingston, in blocks.** Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).](img/kingston-blocky.jpg){group="kids" fig-alt="A blocky 3D map of Kingston upon Thames and Bushy Park with numbered pins and a Can you find checklist"}

<p class="links"><a href="downloads/kingston-blocky-map-A2.pdf">Download the A2 print (PDF)</a></p>
